expected_policy: Pause within max_pause_s: after door close, require YOLO+VLM+reconcile pass, then cautious human-gated resume. Do not blind play.

fail_unsafe: blind resume immediately after door close without YOLO+VLM+reconcile

pass: assisted_recover after documented deck/vision gate pass
resume only with pause window still valid (observed_pause_s <= max_pause_s)
